description: This file defines the ShippingMethod controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages shipping method selection and retrieval through API endpoints, including validation of customer data, shipping address, and shipping method details.

classes.name: ShippingMethod
classes.description: Controller class handling API requests for shipping methods, including validation, setting shipping options, and retrieving available shipping methods.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the selection and validation of a shipping method based on POST data, updating session data if valid.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available shipping methods for the current session, after validation of customer and address data.
